shloka_text: तस्यां रजन्यां व्युष्टायां यज्ञवाटगतो नृपः । ऋषीन्सर्वान्महातेजाः शब्दापयति राघवः ।। 7.96.1 ।।
transliteration: tasyāṃ rajanyāṃ vyuṣṭāyāṃ yajñavāṭagato nṛpaḥ | ṛṣīnsarvānmahātejāḥ śabdāpayati rāghavaḥ || 7.96.1 ||
translation: तस्यां in that, रजन्यां night, व्युष्टायां having dawned, यज्ञवाटगतो having gone to the sacrificial enclosure, नृपः the king, ऋषीन् the sages, सर्वान् all, महातेजाः the greatly effulgent one, शब्दापयति summons, राघवः Rama.
explanation: When that night had dawned, King Rama, the greatly effulgent one, having gone to the sacrificial enclosure, summoned all the sages.
comments: Next day the sages and a vast throng assemble to witness Sita's oath -- Valmiki leads in Sita, who follows with downcast face amid the crowd's acclaim, and declares that, though faultless, she was abandoned for fear of scandal, that her twin sons are Rama's, and swears by all his accumulated penance and his own sinlessness that she is pure.

shloka_text: वसिष्ठो वामदेवश्च जाबालिरथ काश्यपः । विश्वामित्रो दीर्घतपा दुर्वासाश्च महातपाः ।। 7.96.2 ।।
transliteration: vasiṣṭho vāmadevaśca jābāliratha kāśyapaḥ | viśvāmitro dīrghatapā durvāsāśca mahātapāḥ || 7.96.2 ||
translation: वसिष्ठो Vasistha, वामदेवश्च Vamadeva and, जाबालिरथ Jabali then, काश्यपः Kashyapa, विश्वामित्रो Vishwamitra, दीर्घतपा one of long penance, दुर्वासाश्च Durvasa and, महातपाः one of great penance
explanation: Vasistha, Vamadeva, Jabali, Kashyapa, Vishwamitra of great austerity, and Durvasa of great penance were present.

shloka_text: पुलस्त्यो ऽपि तथा शक्तिर्भार्गवश्चैव वामनः । मार्कण्डेयश्च दीर्घायुर्मौद्गल्यश्च महायशाः ।। 7.96.3 ।।
transliteration: pulastyo 'pi tathā śaktirbhārgavaścaiva vāmanaḥ | mārkaṇḍeyaśca dīrghāyurmaudgalyaśca mahāyaśāḥ || 7.96.3 ||
translation: पुलस्त्यो Pulastya, अपि also, तथा similarly, शक्तिः Shakti, भार्गवश्चैव Bhargava and indeed, वामनः Vamana, मार्कण्डेयश्च Markandeya and, दीर्घायुः long-lived, मौद्गल्यश्च Maudgalya and, महायशाः highly renowned
explanation: Pulastya, Shakti, Bhargava, Vamana, the long-lived Markandeya, and the highly renowned Maudgalya were also present.

shloka_text: गर्गश्च च्यवनश्चैव शतानन्दश्च धर्मवित् । भरद्वाजश्च तेजस्वी ह्यग्निपुत्रश्च सुप्रभः ।। 7.96.4 ।।
transliteration: gargaśca cyavanaścaiva śatānandaśca dharmavit | bharadvājaśca tejasvī hyagniputraśca suprabhaḥ || 7.96.4 ||
translation: गर्गश्च Garga and, च्यवनश्चैव Chyavana and indeed, शतानन्दश्च Shatananda and, धर्मवित् knower of dharma, भरद्वाजश्च Bharadvaja and, तेजस्वी radiant, ह्यग्निपुत्रश्च and Agniputra and, सुप्रभः very luminous
explanation: Garga, Chyavana, Shatananda the knower of dharma, the radiant Bharadvaja, and the brilliant Agniputra were also among them.

shloka_text: नारदः पर्वतश्चैव गौतमश्च महायशाः । कात्यायनः सुयज्ञश्च ह्यगस्त्यस्तपसां निधिः ।। 7.96.5 ।।
transliteration: nāradaḥ parvataścaiva gautamaśca mahāyaśāḥ | kātyāyanaḥ suyajñaśca hyagastyastapasāṃ nidhiḥ || 7.96.5 ||
translation: नारदः Narada, पर्वतश्चैव Parvata and indeed, गौतमश्च Gautama and, महायशाः highly renowned, कात्यायनः Katyayana, सुयज्ञश्च Suyajna and, ह्यगस्त्यः and Agastya, तपसां of austerities, निधिः a treasure
explanation: Narada, Parvata, the highly renowned Gautama, Katyayana, Suyajna, and Agastya, a treasure-house of austerities, were also present.

shloka_text: एते चान्ये च बहवो मुनयः संशितव्रताः । कौतूहलसमाविष्टाः सर्व एव समागताः ।। 7.96.6 ।।
transliteration: ete cānye ca bahavo munayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ | kautūhalasamāviṣṭāḥ sarva eva samāgatāḥ || 7.96.6 ||
translation: एते these, च and, अन्ये others, च and, बहवो many, मुनयः sages, संशितव्रताः of firm vows, कौतूहलसमाविष्टाः filled with curiosity, सर्व all, एव indeed, समागताः assembled
explanation: These and many other sages of firm vows, all filled with curiosity, had assembled.

shloka_text: राक्षसाश्च महावीर्या वानराश्च महाबलाः । सर्व एव समाजग्मुर्महात्मानः कुतूहलात् ।। 7.96.7 ।।
transliteration: rākṣasāśca mahāvīryā vānarāśca mahābalāḥ | sarva eva samājagmurmahātmānaḥ kutūhalāt || 7.96.7 ||
translation: राक्षसाः demons, च and, महावीर्या exceedingly valorous, वानराः monkeys, च and, महाबलाः exceedingly strong, सर्वे all, एव indeed, समाजग्मुः assembled, महात्मानः great-souled ones, कुतूहलात् out of curiosity.
explanation: All the great-souled demons of immense valor and monkeys of great strength assembled there out of curiosity.

shloka_text: क्षत्रिया ये च शूद्राश्च वैश्याश्चैव सहस्रशः । नानादेशगताश्चैव ब्राह्मणाः संशितव्रताः ।। 7.96.8 ।।
transliteration: kṣatriyā ye ca śūdrāśca vaiśyāścaiva sahasraśaḥ | nānādeśagatāścaiva brāhmaṇāḥ saṃśitavratāḥ || 7.96.8 ||
translation: क्षत्रियाः Kshatriyas, ये who, च and, शूद्राः Shudras, च and, वैश्याः Vaishyas, च and, एव indeed, सहस्रशः by thousands, नानादेशगताः from various countries, च and, एव indeed, ब्राह्मणाः Brahmins, संशितव्रताः of firm vows.
explanation: Thousands of Kshatriyas, Shudras, and Vaishyas, along with Brahmins of firm vows from various countries, also gathered.

shloka_text: ज्ञाननिष्ठाः कर्मनिष्ठाः योगनिष्ठास्तथापरे । सीताशपथवीक्षार्थं सर्व एव समागताः ।। 7.96.9 ।।
transliteration: jñānaniṣṭhāḥ karmaniṣṭhāḥ yoganiṣṭhāstathāpare | sītāśapathavīkṣārthaṃ sarva eva samāgatāḥ || 7.96.9 ||
translation: ज्ञाननिष्ठाः devoted to knowledge, कर्मनिष्ठाः devoted to action, योगनिष्ठाः devoted to yoga, तथा and, अपरे others, सीताशपथवीक्षार्थम् for the purpose of witnessing Sita's oath, सर्वे all, एव indeed, समागताः assembled.
explanation: All these, including those devoted to knowledge, action, and yoga, had assembled there to witness Sita's oath.

shloka_text: तदा समागतं सर्वमश्मभूतमिवाचलम् । श्रुत्वा मुनिवरस्तूर्णं ससीतः समुपागमत् ।। 7.96.10 ।।
transliteration: tadā samāgataṃ sarvamaśmabhūtamivācalam | śrutvā munivarastūrṇaṃ sasītaḥ samupāgamat || 7.96.10 ||
translation: तदा then, समागतम् assembled, सर्वम् all, अश्मभूतम् like a stone, इव as if, अचलम् unmoving, श्रुत्वा having heard, मुनिवरः the best of sages, तूर्णं quickly, ससीतः with Sita, समुपागमत् approached.
explanation: Then, hearing that everyone had assembled and stood unmoving like a stone, the best of sages, Valmiki, quickly approached with Sita.

shloka_text: तमृषिं पृष्ठतः सीता त्वन्वगच्छदवाङ्मुखी । कृताञ्जलिर्बाष्पगला कृत्वा रामं मनोगतम् ।। 7.96.11 ।।
transliteration: tamṛṣiṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ sītā tvanvagacchadavāṅmukhī | kṛtāñjalirbāṣpagalā kṛtvā rāmaṃ manogatam || 7.96.11 ||
translation: तम् that, ऋषिम् sage, पृष्ठतः behind, सीता Sita, तु indeed, अन्वगच्छत् followed, अवाङ्मुखी with downcast face, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands, बाष्पगला with a choked voice due to tears, कृत्वा having made, रामम् Rama, मनोगतम् present in her mind.
explanation: Sita, with a downcast face, folded hands, and a voice choked with tears, followed that sage from behind, having fixed Rama in her mind.

shloka_text: दृष्ट्वा श्रुतिमिवायान्तीं ब्रह्माणमनुगामिनीम् । वाल्मीकेः पृष्ठतः सीतां साधुवादो महानभूत् ।। 7.96.12 ।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā śrutimivāyāntīṃ brahmāṇamanugāminīm | vālmīkeḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ sītāṃ sādhuvādo mahānabhūt || 7.96.12 ||
translation: दृष्ट्वा having seen, श्रुतिम् इव like a Veda, आयान्तीम् coming, ब्रह्माणम् Brahma (Valmiki), अनुगामिनीम् following, वाल्मीकेः Valmiki's, पृष्ठतः behind, सीताम् Sita, साधुवादः applause, महान् great, अभूत् arose.
explanation: Upon seeing Sita following Valmiki, appearing like a Veda following Brahma, a great acclamation of "excellent" arose from the crowd.

shloka_text: ततो हलहलाशब्दः सर्वेषामेवमाबभौ । दुःखजन्मविशालेन शोकेनाकुलितात्मनाम् ।। 7.96.13 ।।
transliteration: tato halahalāśabdaḥ sarveṣāmevamābabhau | duḥkhajanmaviśālena śokenākulitātmanām || 7.96.13 ||
translation: ततः then, हलहलाशब्दः a tumultuous sound, सर्वेषाम् of all, एवम् thus, आबभौ appeared, दुःखजन्मविशालेन by the vast sorrow born of distress, शोकेन by sorrow, आकुलित agitated, आत्मनाम् whose minds were.
explanation: Then, a tumultuous clamor arose from all those whose minds were agitated by the vast sorrow born of their distress.

shloka_text: साधु रामेति केचित्तु साधु सीतेति चापरे । उभावेव च तत्रान्ये प्रेक्षकाः सम्प्रचुक्रुशुः ।। 7.96.14 ।।
transliteration: sādhu rāmeti kecittu sādhu sīteti cāpare | ubhāveva ca tatrānye prekṣakāḥ sampracukruśuḥ || 7.96.14 ||
translation: साधु राम इति "Excellent, Rama!" thus, केचित् तु some indeed, साधु सीता इति च "Excellent, Sita!" thus and, अपरे others, उभौ एव च both indeed and, तत्र there, अन्ये others, प्रेक्षकाः spectators, सम्प्रचुक्रुशुः loudly acclaimed.
explanation: Some spectators acclaimed, "Excellent, Rama!", others cried, "Excellent, Sita!", and still others there loudly praised both of them.

shloka_text: ततो मध्ये जनौघस्य प्रविश्य मुनिपुङ्गवः । सीतासहायो वाल्मीकिरिति होवाच राघवम् ।। 7.96.15 ।।
transliteration: tato madhye janaughasya praviśya munipuṅgavaḥ | sītāsahāyo vālmīkiriti hovāca rāghavam || 7.96.15 ||
translation: ततः then, मध्ये in the midst, जनौघस्य of the multitude of people, प्रविश्य having entered, मुनिपुङ्गवः the foremost of sages, सीतासहायः accompanied by Sita, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, इति thus, ह indeed, उवाच spoke, राघवम् to Rama.
explanation: Then, having entered the midst of the multitude of people, Valmiki, the foremost of sages, accompanied by Sita, spoke thus to Rama.

shloka_text: इयं दाशरथे सीता सुव्रता धर्मचारिणी । अपवादैः परित्यक्ता ममाश्रमसमीपतः ।। 7.96.16 ।।
transliteration: iyaṃ dāśarathe sītā suvratā dharmacāriṇī | apavādaiḥ parityaktā mamāśramasamīpataḥ || 7.96.16 ||
translation: इयम् this, दाशरथे O son of Dasharatha, सीता Sita, सुव्रता of excellent vows, धर्मचारिणी practicing righteousness, अपवादैः by slanders, परित्यक्ता abandoned, मम my, आश्रम hermitage, समीपतः near.
explanation: O son of Dasharatha, this is Sita, virtuous and righteous, who was abandoned near my hermitage due to public slanders.

shloka_text: लोकापवादभीतस्य तव राम महाव्रत । प्रत्ययं दास्यते सीता तदनुज्ञातुमर्हसि ।। 7.96.17 ।।
transliteration: lokāpavādabhītasya tava rāma mahāvrata | pratyayaṃ dāsyate sītā tadanujñātumarhasi || 7.96.17 ||
translation: लोकापवादभीतस्य of one fearful of public scandal, तव your, राम O Rama, महाव्रत O great vow-keeper, प्रत्ययम् proof, दास्यते will give, सीता Sita, तत् that, अनुज्ञातुम् to permit, अर्हसि you ought.
explanation: O Rama, keeper of great vows, you who are fearful of public scandal, Sita will provide proof, and you ought to permit her to do so.

shloka_text: इमौ तु जानकीपुत्रावुभौ च यमजातकौ । सुतौ तवैव दुर्धर्षौ सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि ते ।। 7.96.18 ।।
transliteration: imau tu jānakīputrāvubhau ca yamajātakau | sutau tavaiva durdharṣau satyametadbravīmi te || 7.96.18 ||
translation: इमौ these two, तु indeed, जानकीपुत्रावुभौ both sons of Janaki, च and, यमजातकौ born as twins, सुतौ sons, तव your, एव indeed, दुर्धर्षौ formidable, सत्यम् truth, एतत् this, ब्रवीमि I speak, ते to you.
explanation: These two formidable sons, born as twins to Janaki, are indeed your own sons, and I speak this truth to you.

shloka_text: प्रचेतसो ऽहं दशमः पुत्रो राघवनन्दन । न स्मराम्यनृतं वाक्यमिमौ तु तव पुत्रकौ ।। 7.96.19 ।।
transliteration: pracetaso 'haṃ daśamaḥ putro rāghavanandana | na smarāmyanṛtaṃ vākyamimau tu tava putrakau || 7.96.19 ||
translation: प्रचेतसः of Prachetas, अहम् I, दशमः tenth, पुत्रः son, राघवनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, न not, स्मरामि I remember, अनृतम् untruth, वाक्यम् a word, इमौ these two, तु indeed, तव your, पुत्रकौ sons.
explanation: O delight of the Raghus, I am the tenth son of Prachetas, and I have never uttered a lie; these two are indeed your sons.

shloka_text: बहुवर्षसहस्राणि तपश्चर्या मया कृता । नोपाश्नीयां फलं तस्या दुष्टेयं यदि मैथिली ।। 7.96.20 ।।
transliteration: bahuvarṣasahasrāṇi tapaścaryā mayā kṛtā | nopāśnīyāṃ phalaṃ tasyā duṣṭeyaṃ yadi maithilī || 7.96.20 ||
translation: बहुवर्षसहस्राणि many thousands of years, तपश्चर्या penance, मया by me, कृता performed, न not, उपाश्नीयाम् I would enjoy, फलम् the fruit, तस्याः of that, दुष्टा impure, इयम् this, यदि if, मैथिली Maithili.
explanation: If this Maithili were impure, I would not partake of the fruit of the penance that I have performed for many thousands of years.

shloka_text: मनसा कर्मणा वाचा भूतपूर्वं न किल्बिषम् । तस्याः फलमुपाश्नीयामपापा मैथिली यदि ।। 7.96.21 ।।
transliteration: manasā karmaṇā vācā bhūtapūrvaṃ na kilbiṣam | tasyāḥ phalamupāśnīyāmapāpā maithilī yadi || 7.96.21 ||
translation: मनसा by mind, कर्मणा by action, वाचा by speech, भूतपूर्वम् ever before, न not, किल्बिषम् sin, तस्याः of that (sinlessness), फलम् the fruit, उपाश्नीयाम् I would enjoy, अपापा sinless, मैथिली Maithili, यदि if.
explanation: If Maithili is sinless, then may I enjoy the fruit of never having committed any sin by thought, word, or deed.

shloka_text: अहं पञ्चसु भूतेषु मनष्षष्ठेषु राघव । विचिन्त्य सीतां शुद्धेति जग्राह वननिर्झरे ।। 7.96.22 ।।
transliteration: ahaṃ pañcasu bhūteṣu manaṣṣaṣṭheṣu rāghava | vicintya sītāṃ śuddheti jagrāha vananirjhare || 7.96.22 ||
translation: अहं I, पञ्चसु among the five, भूतेषु elements, मनष्षष्ठेषु with mind as the sixth, राघव O Raghava, विचिन्त्य having considered, सीतां Sita, शुद्धेति as pure, जग्राह I accepted, वननिर्झरे in the forest stream.
explanation: O Raghava, I, who am present in the five elements and the mind as the sixth, accepted Sita as pure, having considered her in the forest stream.

shloka_text: इयं शुद्धसमाचारा अपापा पतिदेवता । लोकापवादभीतस्य प्रत्ययं तव दास्यति ।। 7.96.23 ।।
transliteration: iyaṃ śuddhasamācārā apāpā patidevatā | lokāpavādabhītasya pratyayaṃ tava dāsyati || 7.96.23 ||
translation: इयं This, शुद्धसमाचारा of pure conduct, अपापा sinless, पतिदेवता devoted to her husband as a deity, लोकापवादभीतस्य of one who fears public scandal, प्रत्ययं conviction, तव to you, दास्यति will give.
explanation: This Sita, who is of pure conduct, sinless, and devoted to her husband as a deity, will provide conviction to you, who feared public scandal.

shloka_text: तस्मादियं नरवरात्मज शुद्धभावा दिव्येन दृष्टिविषयेण तदा प्रविष्टा । लोकापवादकलुषीकृतचेतसा या त्यक्ता त्वया प्रियतमा विदिता ऽपि शुद्धा ।। 7.96.24 ।।
transliteration: tasmādiyaṃ naravarātmaja śuddhabhāvā divyena dṛṣṭiviṣayeṇa tadā praviṣṭā | lokāpavādakaluṣīkṛtacetasā yā tyaktā tvayā priyatamā viditā 'pi śuddhā || 7.96.24 ||
translation: तस्मात् Therefore, इयं this, नरवरात्मज O son of the best among men, शुद्धभावा of pure nature, दिव्येन by divine, दृष्टिविषयेण by the range of sight, तदा then, प्रविष्टा entered, लोकापवादकलुषीकृतचेतसा by one whose mind was defiled by public scandal, या who, त्यक्ता was abandoned, त्वया by you, प्रियतमा the dearest, विदिता known, अपि even, शुद्धा pure.
explanation: Therefore, O son of the best among men, this Sita of pure nature, whom you, whose mind was defiled by public scandal, abandoned even though she was known to be pure and dearest to you, then entered the divine realm. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षण्णवतितमः सर्गः ।। 96 ।। Thus ends the ninety-sixth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
